measured_source: Base plus common untimed layout fingerprint; after additionally uses four-point tiled reassignment. No two-means or provider routing change.

protocol.phase_comparison: same three-layer SIMD baseline versus tiled reassignment; two-means unchanged
protocol.quality: Independent exhaustive L2 top10 on all base vectors; deterministic 256 queries

corpus.transformation: Exact FP16-to-FP32 promotion; original rows; no normalization

caveats: Windows desktop system activity was not controlled. All post-warmup stalls retained.
Approximate 95% intervals resample eight paired process rounds in 20000 deterministic bootstrap draws; serial correlation is not modeled.
Two-means implementation is unchanged. Its time difference is not a two-means optimization claim.
256 of 6380 fixed evenly spaced queries; complete 958152-vector base; one quality pass per configuration.
Search throughput is not tested with warmed repeated measurements.
Layout fingerprint is DefaultHasher at the same toolchain, not a cryptographic proof or a stable storage format.
In-memory logical vector/list scans do not establish physical SSD IO or Mimir write amplification.
